name: Hatfield Grid · realistic network
description: The Hatfield core grid from the ARTIS reference report, north to south: Stanza Bopape (two-way), Pretorius (4 lanes westbound), Francis Baard (4 lanes eastbound), Arcadia (two-way, to just short of Jan Shoba), the Park (eastbound) / Burnett (westbound) one-way pair, Prospect and South (1 + 1 two-way, Prospect meeting Jan Shoba only through left-turn roads), then Duxbury (1 + 1 west of Jan Shoba, 2 + 2 east of it), Lunnon (1 + 1, meeting Jan Shoba only through left-turn roads) and Lynnwood square to Jan Shoba where it bends 30 degrees west; east of Jan Shoba Duxbury turns south-east across Lunnon and meets Lynnwood square on, carrying on south of it as 1 + 1. West to east: Festival (one-way northbound, Prospect to Stanza), Hilda (one-way southbound from Stanza, bending into Duxbury), Grosvenor (two-way, Stanza to South) - all three narrow to 1 + 1 two-way south of Burnett and Jan Shoba - a one-way pair (southbound east, northbound west, 4 lanes, 3 south of Francis Baard) that merges into one divided road at Arcadia. Lane counts, lane use and distances are simulation estimates, not survey data.

meta.axes: x increases east, y increases south (screen convention)
meta.source: ARTIS - Hatfield Realistic Traffic Network Reference Report (City of Tshwane Hatfield Metropolitan Node Precinct Plan for the road hierarchy and one-way system). Road existence, directionality and hierarchy are documented; lane counts, lane use and distances are ARTIS approximations.
meta.layout: North to south: Stanza Bopape, Pretorius, Francis Baard, Arcadia, Park, Burnett, Prospect, South, then past Jan Shoba's 30 degree bend Duxbury, Lunnon, Lynnwood. West to east: Festival, Hilda, Grosvenor, Jan Shoba. Grosvenor, Hilda and Festival start at Stanza Bopape as T-junctions; Grosvenor ends at South and Festival at Prospect (T-junctions), and Hilda bends into Duxbury. South of Burnett, Festival, Hilda and Grosvenor are 1 + 1 two-way streets (50 km/h, an estimate). Arcadia runs from the western edge like the other streets and stops 20 m short of Jan Shoba. Prospect and Lunnon do not cross Jan Shoba: each half stops short of it and their lanes curve into and out of Jan Shoba as left-turn roads (no junction; merging cars give way, about 10% of Jan Shoba traffic turns off). East of Jan Shoba Duxbury turns 45 degrees right, crosses Lunnon, bends again to meet Lynnwood square on and carries on south of it as a 1 + 1 street. Streets that start at a T carry only the traffic that turns into them.
meta.distanceSource: Festival-Hilda-Grosvenor-Jan Shoba 245 m (the northbound Jan Shoba carriageway 245 m past Grosvenor at Francis Baard and 243 m at Pretorius and Stanza, where it is a lane wider on its kerb side, the southbound one another 245 m east; they merge 70 m south of Arcadia). North-south: Stanza-Pretorius 275 and Pretorius-Francis Baard 164 from the report; Francis Baard-Arcadia, Arcadia-Park, Park-Burnett, Burnett-Prospect and Prospect-South 250 (estimates); South to the bend 100, bend to Duxbury 300, Duxbury-Lunnon 280, Lunnon-Lynnwood 320 (estimates, reusing the report's block lengths); Duxbury east turns 140 m past Jan Shoba (estimate).
meta.directions: Francis Baard and Park eastbound, Pretorius and Burnett westbound, Hilda southbound, Festival northbound. Jan Shoba north of Arcadia: the east carriageway southbound, the west one northbound (left-hand traffic), 4 lanes each north of Francis Baard and 3 south of it.
meta.speeds: Francis Baard, Pretorius, Lynnwood and Stanza Bopape 60 km/h; Jan Shoba, Grosvenor, Hilda and Festival 60 km/h (kept at the posted limit rather than the report's 50); every other street 50 km/h.
meta.demandSource: Sinusoidal fluctuation between min and max, 300 s period, following the report's demand hierarchy (high: Francis Baard, Pretorius, Jan Shoba, Lynnwood; medium: Burnett, Park, Grosvenor, Hilda, Festival, Stanza Bopape; lower: the rest). A simulation-demand hierarchy, not measured volumes. Pretorius, Francis Baard, Jan Shoba, Stanza Bopape, Grosvenor, Hilda and Festival ranges were narrowed (2026-09-25) so fixed-time and green wave reach a steady state: the original peaks oversaturated the M2 × Jan Shoba junctions under fixed timing and queues grew for hours. Hierarchy holds by total road volume (lanes × rate).
meta.laneUse: Report section 22: kerb lane left + straight, inner lanes straight, median lane straight + right, minus any turn the junction does not offer (a one-way cross street only takes one of them). Pretorius & Jan Shoba has two left-turn lanes (report section 5). One entry per lane, kerb lane (leftmost, SA) first; a two-way street keys it by direction of travel.
meta.joins: Where carriageways join (Jan Shoba's merge at Arcadia, Hilda into Duxbury, Jan Shoba's lane drop at Francis Baard, Duxbury at Jan Shoba where it becomes its own road to cross Lunnon and reach Lynnwood, and Festival, Hilda and Grosvenor at Burnett where they narrow) the corridor lists `joins`: cars reaching the end of one road drive straight onto the next. At each narrowing the kerb lane of the wider road is turn-only (Grosvenor southbound at Burnett, Duxbury westbound at Jan Shoba as a short left-turn lane). The northbound lane of Hilda ends at Burnett because Hilda is one-way north of it. Where the Jan Shoba pair meets the divided road, the kerb lane each side tapers over 40 m (southbound a lane drop, northbound a lane gain); at Francis Baard the southbound kerb lane is left-turn only because the road drops to 3 lanes past it. The Lunnon turn roads merge into and peel off the Jan Shoba kerb lanes partway along it.
